basic_profile.bio: A passionate car enthusiast hailing from Tampa, Florida. I've been into all things automotive since my teens, and I have a particular soft spot for the Mazda Miata. When I'm not tinkering with my NB Miata, you can find me exploring new mods in Minecraft or leveling up in Grow Castle. I work as a mechanical engineer by day, which fuels my love for precision and performance. In a committed relationship with my partner, who shares my love for adventure and online gaming. I typically browse Reddit during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in cars comes from years of hands-on experience and a degree in mechanical engineering. I've worked in the automotive sector for over a decade, focusing on performance parts and custom builds. My gaming knowledge is self-taught, stemming from countless hours spent playing and experimenting with different strategies.
